jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Paragon Cyber Solutions is seeking a Data Scientist to support a Government intelligence mission. In this role, you will apply statistics, machine learning, data mining, and other data science techniques to large volumes of intelligence data to identify trends, support predictive analysis, and deliver clear findings to decision makers. You will develop and integrate algorithms that support intelligence search and discovery, recommend best practices for managing data, and produce written, visual, and verbal products that communicate complex technical results.

Clearance: TS/SCI with ability to obtain and maintain CI polygraph

Responsibilities:

Apply mathematics, statistics, information science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, network science, probability modeling, data mining, data engineering, data warehousing, data compression, data protection, and other scientific techniques to translate complex technical findings into graphical, written, visual, and verbal products
Identify trends in existing intelligence data and leverage other Intelligence Community (IC) data sources
Develop and use machine learning, data mining, and prediction algorithms based on open-source capabilities
Integrate or code algorithms to support Government intelligence search and discovery missions
Recommend best practices for managing data within hardware, software, storage, and bandwidth constraints
Apply data science techniques to support predictive analysis, social media and crowd-sourced data analytics, wargaming, and strategy development
Use exploratory analysis and rapid iteration on large volumes of data to quickly derive intelligence
Prepare products that describe and document findings and activities

Requirements

Bachelor's degree preferred, with four (4) years of relevant experience
Proficiency in Python, R, or SQL for data analysis and modeling
Experience developing and applying machine learning models using open-source tools (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar)
Experience with data mining, statistical analysis, and predictive modeling techniques
Experience analyzing large, complex datasets to identify trends and produce findings
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Hands-on experience with relational and/or NoSQL database systems
Familiarity with cloud computing and data management within storage and bandwidth constraints
Experience with version control systems such as Git
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to clearly communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders in written, visual, and verbal formats

Benefits

Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
Retirement Plan (401K w/ employer matching)
Paid Time Off & 11 Paid Public Holidays
Short and Long-Term Disability
Healthy Work-Life Balance
Training & Development

Why Work For Paragon Cyber Solutions?

You want to make a difference. You want to be recognized by name versus being a number. You want to work with a company where you can grow and work in different areas to increase your knowledge/experience.

A Model of Excellence

That's our motto in all we do and what we seek in our team members.

Are you a hardworking professional seeking a new opportunity that fosters growth? Look no further!

We are an award-winning minority, woman, veteran-owned, 8(a), EDWOSB, SDVOSB, Tampa, FL-based small business. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality solutions that help our clients protect the integrity of their business operations.

Salary 145K-170K.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Strategist (FDS)
jobs.description:
About the Role

Brillio is seeking an experienced business transformation and product leader to serve as a Forward Deployed Strategist. In this role, you will embed directly within a complex business domain, rapidly understand how the operation works, identify high-value problems, and lead cross-functional teams from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and measurable value realization.
The FDS operates at the intersection of business strategy, process design, product, technology, data, organizational change, and executive decision-making. This is not a traditional advisory role that concludes with a recommendation, nor is it a project coordination role centered on schedules and status reporting. You will stay with the problem, shape the future state, work directly with solution builders, drive decisions and adoption, and use evidence to determine whether a solution should scale, change, transfer, pause, or stop.

Preferred Locations:
Minneapolis, Chicago, Dallas, NYC

What You Will Do

Discover and Frame the Right Problem

Learn the business model, workflows, users, economics, constraints, and current pain points.
Challenge the initial request to identify the underlying customer or business problem.
Identify opportunities to eliminate, simplify, redesign, automate, or better enable work.
Translate ambiguity into a clear problem statement, opportunity definition, and decision path.

Define Outcomes and Product Direction

Define the target outcome, customer need, scope, success measures, priorities, and decision rights.
Shape the future-state workflow and product or capability concept before committing to build.
Create and maintain a practical roadmap covering hypotheses, proof points, dependencies, tradeoffs, and sequencing.
Apply AI and automation where they improve the business result, rather than treating technology as the objective.

Lead Cross-Functional Delivery

Partner directly with engineering, subject-matter experts, product, data, architecture, operations, compliance, finance, and business stakeholders.
Set priorities, clarify decisions, manage dependencies, remove ambiguity, and keep the team focused on outcomes.
Work credibly with technical teams on data, integrations, governance, cost, scalability, security, and production constraints.
Ensure the delivered capability remains aligned with the intended business and user outcome.

Drive Adoption and Operating Change

Prepare the organization for changes to processes, roles, communications, controls, and operating practices.
Stay close to frontline users and leaders, converting feedback into product and workflow improvements.
Define ownership and operating mechanisms so the capability becomes part of normal business operations.
Anticipate resistance, surface risks early, and create a practical path to sustained adoption.

Own Value Realization

Establish the baseline, expected benefit, cost, KPIs, evidence plan, and definition of success.
Monitor performance after deployment and communicate results, risks, and learning.
Recommend whether to scale, refine, transfer, pause, or stop based on measurable evidence.
Remain accountable from initial discovery through deployment, adoption, and realized business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Typically 10+ years of relevant experience in strategy, consulting, healthcare transformation, product or capability strategy, operations leadership, technology strategy, or a related field.
Demonstrated ownership of complex, cross-functional change from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and measurable results.
Proven ability to learn a complex operating model quickly, synthesize input from frontline experts, and build sufficient domain depth to make sound decisions.
Experience shaping products, capabilities, workflows, processes, or operating-model changes using user needs, outcomes, roadmaps, priorities, and tradeoffs.
Strong business judgment, including the ability to assess value, feasibility, risk, strategic fit, and investment choices when information is incomplete.
Executive-level written and verbal communication, facilitation, storytelling, and stakeholder influence without direct authority.
Technical fluency across AI, automation, data, software delivery, integration, and enterprise technology, sufficient to work directly with engineering teams and challenge assumptions.
Experience establishing business cases, baselines, success measures, and value-realization plans.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, move from analysis to action, and maintain personal accountability for outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in healthcare, pharmacy benefit management, health services, insurance, regulated operations, or another complex enterprise environment.
Background in management consulting, product leadership, digital transformation, enterprise operations, or technology-enabled business transformation.
Hands-on experience shaping AI-enabled or data-driven products and workflows, with appropriate consideration for governance, risk, and operating controls.
Experience working in multidisciplinary pods or product teams spanning business, engineering, data, architecture, operations, and subject-matter experts.
Experience leading proofs of value, pilots, MVPs, or capability launches and using evidence to make scale-or-stop decisions.

What Success Looks Like

The team is solving a clearly defined, high-value business or customer problem rather than simply delivering a requested feature.
The future-state workflow, desired outcome, scope, decision rights, and success measures are understood and aligned.
Cross-functional decisions are made at the appropriate level and delivery remains connected to business priorities.
Users and operating teams adopt the capability, with feedback incorporated into ongoing improvement.
Business value is measured against a baseline and leaders receive evidence-based recommendations on next steps.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This opportunity is well suited to a hands-on transformation leader who combines strategic thinking with end-to-end execution. The strongest candidates will demonstrate learning agility, product thinking, technical fluency, executive communication, stakeholder leadership, value discipline, and ownership through implementation and adoption.

Apply

Interested candidates should apply with a resume that highlights end-to-end transformation ownership, cross-functional leadership, and measurable business outcomes. Be prepared to discuss two or three representative engagements, including the problem addressed, your personal role, decisions made, actions led, and results achieved.

Equal Opportunity and Engagement Terms

Candidate consideration and engagement terms are subject to applicable sourcing, background, compliance, and company requirements. Brillio supports fair and consistent candidate consideration. Applicants should not include protected or non-job-related personal information in their submissions.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Company Description
Glasslake, formerly Luzid, helps enterprises and system integrators accelerate SAP transformation with agentic AI. Its platform connects knowledge across enterprise systems, documents, and teams, enabling people to understand complex SAP environments and apply their expertise more effectively. Glasslake supports the full transformation lifecycle, from requirements analysis and impact assessment to documentation and testing, reducing manual work and improving decision-making. The company focuses on making expertise reusable so organizations can scale capabilities across projects and initiatives. Glasslake brings together AI builders, SAP specialists, and experienced enterprise advisors, combining entrepreneurial ambition with deep practical knowledge of enterprise systems and processes.

Role Description
The Solutions Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in San Francisco, CA. This role designs and validates end-to-end solutions that leverage Glasslake’s agentic AI platform to address complex SAP transformation needs for enterprise customers and partners. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with clients to understand business processes and requirements, translating them into solution architectures, and defining integration patterns with existing SAP and non-SAP systems. The Solutions Architect works closely with consulting, product, and software development teams to create implementation plans, oversee technical design reviews, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable. The role also involves producing technical documentation, supporting proof-of-concept initiatives, providing guidance during testing and deployment, and contributing field feedback to refine Glasslake’s platform and best practices.

Qualifications

Strong Solution Architecture skills, including designing scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise solutions.
Consulting experience, with the ability to gather requirements, facilitate workshops, and advise stakeholders on SAP transformation strategies.
Hands-on Software Development background, with familiarity in modern application architectures and APIs.
Integration expertise across SAP and non-SAP systems, including data flows, middleware, and interoperability patterns.
Deep understanding of Business Process design and optimization within complex enterprise environments.
Experience with SAP landscapes (e.g., S/4HANA, ECC, BW, or related modules) and enterprise AI or automation platforms.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Track record of working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams in fast-paced environments.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in global or large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives is highly beneficial.

jobs.description:

The role

Build robust, scalable training and inference pipelines for deep learning
Work inside the internals of open-source deep learning frameworks and extend what they can do
Hunt down and remove performance bottlenecks
Partner closely with researchers and fellow engineers
Build deep knowledge of how the trading systems work

You'll be part of a collaborative, high-performing culture built around curious thinkers and inventive problem-solvers, tackling some of the hardest challenges in financial markets alongside genuinely strong colleagues.
Colleagues drawn from 40+ nationalities

Firm-wide profit share plus performance-linked bonus

Strong low-level GPU programming in CUDA — Tensor Cores, cooperative groups, graphs, warp-level intrinsics

A major market maker active on 100+ exchanges worldwide, focused on improving markets by adding liquidity, pricing accurately and increasing transparency in all conditions — with the health and efficiency of those markets a priority for every participant.
